headline: Master your music.
Hear every move.
hero.body: For artists, producers and anyone making music. Start with a style you love, then make it yours—all on your Mac or Windows PC.
hero.micro: No audio upload. One-time purchase at paid launch.

headline: Start simple.
Make it yours.
workflow.body: Drop in your finished mix. Like what you hear? Create your master. Want to go further? These controls are yours to explore.

steps.title: Choose a style.
steps.body: Start with a character, not a genre label. Find a favorite and make it your starting point.

steps.title: Make it yours.
steps.body: Adjust Intensity for a light touch or a stronger character. Hear it while the track plays.

steps.title: Set the loudness.
steps.body: Low, Medium or High. Then Create Master writes a separate WAV.

advanced.body: Shape tone, dynamics, width and warmth without stopping the track. Flip between Original and Mastered at the same playhead.
advanced.ab_note: Volume Match is optional, off by default, and changes listening level only—not your export.

headline: Your ears decide.
The measurements explain.
export.body: A target is a setting. A receipt describes the rendered file. Check delivered loudness, true peak and dynamic range alongside what you hear.
export.source_note: Your source stays untouched. Exports are written separately.
export.standard: Filename, delivered loudness, and a Show file action. Genuine integrity problems remain visible.
export.advanced: Warning-aware Track Master review and a detailed post-render receipt.

sound.body: Start with a character, not a genre label. Every style uses the same loudness and safety stages. Intensity is how you make it yours.
sound.adaptive_heading: It also knows when to do less.
sound.adaptive_body: Source analysis can ease selected boosts and compression density when your mix calls for restraint. Already-processed tracks are welcome.

headline: One record.
One shared direction.
album.body: Set the sound for your album. Give individual tracks their own treatment when they need it. Keep one delivery format across the record.
album.limits: Audio mastering and delivery—not DDP authoring. No cue sheets, ISRC metadata or guaranteed gapless playback.

headline: A real tool.
A straightforward deal.
beta.body: Free during the beta. No email gate. At paid launch, one purchase—not a subscription.
beta.pricing: Planned launch pricing: $29 founder / $49 standard. Founder-window dates and terms are announced when confirmed.

faq.a: No YES Master account. Processing runs locally on your Mac or Windows PC; audio is not uploaded for mastering.
A 44.1 kHz / 24-bit WAV, with the limiter ceiling set to −1 dBTP. Advanced adds custom delivery choices.

faq.q: Does the beta expire on my computer?
faq.a: An installed beta build keeps working when the beta closes. The installers can be withdrawn; the build has no kill switch.
Feedback is optional. Structured reports go through GitHub, which requires a GitHub account to post.

headline: Finish this track.
Start the next.
closing.body: From the first comparison to the final WAV. Less setup between you and the sound you want.
closing.micro: Mac and Windows. Runs locally. No YES Master account.
